import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset from csv file
data = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Create a histogram of price distribution
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.histplot(data['price_usd'], kde=True)
plt.title('Price Distribution of Cameras')
plt.xlabel('Price (USD)')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a bar chart of top camera brands by price
top_brands = data.groupby('brand')['price_usd'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False).head(10)
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.barplot(x=top_brands.index, y=top_brands.values)
plt.title('Top Camera Brands by Price')
plt.xlabel('Brand')
plt.ylabel('Average Price (USD)')
plt.savefig('output1.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a scatter plot of megapixels vs. price
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.scatterplot(x='megapixels', y='price_usd', data=data)
plt.title('Megapixels vs. Price')
plt.xlabel('Megapixels')
plt.ylabel('Price (USD)')
plt.savefig('output2.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a box plot of weight distribution by body type
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.boxplot(x='body_type', y='weight_grams', data=data)
plt.title('Weight Distribution by Body Type')
plt.xlabel('Body Type')
plt.ylabel('Weight (grams)')
plt.savefig('output3.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
